subject: general
question: Select the synonym of **Candid.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Frank**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"candid"** means being open, honest, and straightforward in speech or expression. (ईमानदार, स्पष्टवादी)

 
 
• **Example:** She gave a candid account of the challenges she faced during the project.
 
 
 
• **"Frank"** is a synonym of "candid" and refers to being open, sincere, and honest in expression or behavior. (स्पष्टवादी)
 
 
• **Example:** He was frank about his feelings during the discussion.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word **'candid'** and **'frank'** convey the same meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Frank**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dubious** (संदेहपूर्ण): Hesitating or doubting; uncertain or unreliable.

 
 
• **Example:** She looked dubious about the accuracy of the report.
 
 
 
• **Insincere** (कपटी): Not expressing genuine feelings or thoughts; dishonest.
 
 
• **Example:** His apology sounded insincere, as if he didn’t mean it.
 
 
 
• **Secretive** (गोपनीय): Inclined to keep one’s thoughts, feelings, or intentions hidden.
 
 
• **Example:** He was always secretive about his personal life.
